data.image_source: existing 200-image validation feature cache and corresponding cached COCO val JPEGs
data.target_categories: per-image annotated categories whose union GT occupies at least 2 cells on the 16x16 grid

dino_text.template_features: Encode each COCO category template; average seven template embeddings per class before each MLP text projection.

experiment: Track B Talk2DINO-SigLIP Phase 3 spatial segmentation validation

geometry.input: 224x224 Talk2DINO transform: bicubic short-edge resize, torchvision CenterCrop geometry, ImageNet mean/std on image path
geometry.mask: same short-edge resize/crop geometry, nearest-neighbor discrete IDs, then nearest 16x16 grid
geometry.scores: bilinear upsample to aligned 224x224 using align_corners=True

outputs.auroc: rank AUROC of soft maps vs binary masks
outputs.bootstrap: paired image resampling, 10000 draws for corrected-vs-original, seed 20261119
outputs.pointing: argmax score cell/pixel lies in target mask
outputs.size_bins: small 2-3 positive grid cells; medium 4-15; large >=16

segmentation.raw_similarity: cosine between normalized cached final DINO patch descriptors and normalized projected category text vectors
segmentation.semantic_union: all instances per category are unioned; crowd regions included; this is semantic category localization, not individual instance segmentation
segmentation.soft_map: sigmoid(raw cosine), upstream DINOTextSim2Mask soft-mask path
segmentation.threshold_origin: Upstream COCO-object evaluation configuration bg_thresh=0.54, carried over as reference and not calibrated for SigLIP
